entities.name: Broadcast MRB Release
entities.description: Procedure for releasing broadcast Multicast Radio Bearer (MRB) for MBS broadcast service, including releasing associated protocol entities and informing upper layers.

entities.name: PDCP Entity
entities.description: Packet Data Convergence Protocol entity associated with the broadcast MRB.

entities.name: RLC Entity
entities.description: Radio Link Control entity associated with the broadcast MRB.

entities.name: MAC and Physical Layer Configuration
entities.description: MAC layer and physical layer configuration related to the broadcast MRB.

entities.name: Temporary Mobile Group Identity
entities.description: Identifier for the MBS broadcast service associated with the released MRB.

entities.name: SDAP Entity
entities.description: Service Data Adaptation Protocol entity associated with the TMGI.

entities.name: No Associated MRB Condition
entities.description: Condition where the SDAP entity has no associated Multicast Radio Bearer.

relations.description: Broadcast MRB release procedure results in release of PDCP entity.
Broadcast MRB release procedure results in release of RLC entity.
Broadcast MRB release procedure results in release of MAC and physical layer configuration.
Broadcast MRB release procedure informs upper layers about release by indicating TMGI.
Condition where SDAP entity has no associated MRB guards the release of SDAP entity.
Broadcast MRB release procedure results in release of SDAP entity when no associated MRB condition is met.
